messages:
alexander_choi: seeing a sudden spike of 504s from hosted-api EU1 since ~14:23 UTC, multiple customer sessions hanging, ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-2157
maria_gomez: can you paste a sample request id + trace id? any common tenant? :eyes:
alexander_choi: trace=6d8f3b2c, tenant=partner-acme, noticed >200 concurrent long-poll/stream requests to /v1/infer/batch across a handful of frontdoor instances
sam_kapoor: adding the simple curl we used to repro locally
sam_kapoor: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-3.2","inputs":["a","b","c"],"stream":true}' \
  https://hosted-api.eu1.redwood.ai/v1/infer
```
alexander_choi: envoy frontdoor logs show upstream response time climbing, then immediate 504s returned to client:
alexander_choi: ```
[2026-03-20T14:24:01Z] "POST /v1/infer HTTP/2" 504 NR - 0 0 3 - "trace=6d8f3b2c" "envoy-upstream-rq-time=3.514"
```
maria_gomez: interesting — backend auth-cache (redis) p99 latency spiked around the same window, looks like auth backend started throttling and increased auth lookup latency
jordan_lee: @eng-sre FYI, check midproxy conn_queue and h2 stream counts, possible head-of-line blocking causing frontdoor to hit stream timeouts
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/hostedapi-2026-03-20-14:15 by sam_kapoor :rocket:
sam_kapoor: noted the 14:15 deploy, we can rollback if needed but first do triage: can we reproduce with X-Tenant header set to partner-acme?
alexander_choi: repro steps for support: set X-Tenant: partner-acme and burst ~300 requests (10rps) with stream=true payload; we saw queue growth and then 504s from frontdoor within ~90s
sam_kapoor: quick mitigation applied: bumped ingress timeout to 45s for EU1 and temporarily disabled auth prefetching for partner-acme :wrench:
maria_gomez: applied a short-term edge rate-limit for partner-acme at 200rps to stop the saturation, documented in the incident notes
ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-0320-01 and linked to CS-2157
jordan_lee: after the throttle, 504s dropped back to baseline within ~3 minutes; customer confirmed degraded but functional UX :thumbsup:
alexander_choi: actions: (1) deep-dive auth-cache redis p99 and any new throttles, (2) add tenant-specific circuit-breaker at edge, (3) schedule postmortem and customer comms
sam_kapoor: I'll open a PR for a circuit-breaker + stress-test harness in staging, and ping @eng-ml for model request pattern analysis
maria_gomez: I'll draft a customer message explaining the mitigation and next steps, include repro details and ETA
alexander_choi: handing off to eng-sre for root cause, will update INC and CS tickets with repro and mitigation notes — marking this thread for follow-up :white_check_mark:
